BIOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transport.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Specimen Collection and Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Specimen Collection and Preservation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
